name: blazer
readme_excerpt: Blazer Explore your data with SQL. Easily create charts and dashboards, and share them with your team. Try it out Blazer is also available as a Docker image. :tangerine: Battle-tested at Instacart Features - Multiple data sources - PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redshift, and many more - Variables - run the same queries with different values - Checks & alerts - get emailed when bad data appears - Audits - all queries are tracked - Security - works with your authentication system Docs - Installation - Queri…
